## 2026-03-06

- **Figure audit + asset cleanup** — Verified the capability/policy/emerging report figures against the actual rendered image contents, corrected the country excellence captions in `final_report_site/docs/report_2_4_1_country_performance.qmd` and `final_report_site/docs/parts/report_2_4_1_country_performance.md`, repointed country top/bottom panels to semantic `country_top_bottom10_*` asset names, and removed stale duplicate assets left under misleading legacy filenames.
- **Institution docs chart completion** — Generated `final_report_site/Final_Report_MD/report_assets/institution_avg_docs_log_3yr_biomedical.png` and `final_report_site/Final_Report_MD/report_assets/institution_avg_docs_log_3yr_quantum.png` from `Data/org_yearly_paper_count_stdscience_2000_2024.xlsx`, then updated the institution performance sources (`final_report_site/docs/report_2_4_2_institution_performance.qmd`, `final_report_site/docs/parts/report_2_4_2_institution_performance.md`) so the “문헌 수 시계열” captions match the plotted content.
- **Semantic asset renames** — Replaced generic `image_6.png`–`image_14.png` references with descriptive filenames across policy/emerging report sources and print rename maps (`final_report_site/docs/report_2_4_3_policy_alignment.qmd`, `final_report_site/docs/parts/report_2_4_3_policy_alignment.md`, `final_report_site/docs/report_3_3_2_emergence_scoring.qmd`, `final_report_site/docs/parts/report_3_3_2_emergence_scoring.md`, `final_report_site/print/asset_rename_map.csv`, `kriss_print_toolkit/print/asset_rename_map.csv`).
- **Figure label normalization** — Renamed the remaining standalone report figure ids from legacy `fig-org-*` labels to `fig-country-*` / `fig-institution-*` in `final_report_site/docs/report_2_4_1_country_performance.qmd` and `final_report_site/docs/report_2_4_2_institution_performance.qmd` so the figure labels match the underlying subject and asset semantics.
- **Institution asset normalization** — Renamed institution performance chart assets from legacy `org_*` filenames to `institution_*`, removed the leftover `_1` suffix from institution top/bottom panels, and synced the report/print references in `final_report_site/docs/report_2_4_2_institution_performance.qmd`, `final_report_site/docs/parts/report_2_4_2_institution_performance.md`, `final_report_site/Final_Report_MD/최종보고서 내용 2c4c6e66ff88807cb40fffc981037ae6.md`, `final_report_site/print/asset_rename_map.csv`, and `kriss_print_toolkit/print/asset_rename_map.csv`.
- **Interactive institution raw-data table** — Kept the 2 summary tables static for readability and added a separate raw-data DataTable (5개 영역 × 11개 기관 × 25개 연도) via `final_report_site/docs/parts/generated/institution_docs_raw_table.md`, with search and per-column select filters wired through `final_report_site/docs/assets/js/datatable-init.js`.
- **Filtered table export** — Added `CSV` / `TSV` export buttons to the filtered institution raw-data table so users can download the currently filtered rows directly from the interactive toolbar via `final_report_site/docs/assets/js/datatable-init.js`.
- **Raw-table sorting** — Enabled header-click sorting on the institution raw-data DataTable and inferred numeric column types (`연도`, `문헌 수`) in `final_report_site/docs/assets/js/datatable-init.js` so the interactive table sorts values numerically instead of lexically.
- **기관 문헌 수 시계열 차트** — 영역과 기관을 선택하며 비교할 수 있는 시계열 차트를 기관 성과 섹션에 추가하고, 정적 시계열 그림과 가까운 색상 체계로 조정했다.
- **도구 페이지 분리 + 기간 제어** — 기관 문헌 수 시계열을 `final_report_site/docs/institution_docs_explorer.qmd`로 옮기고, 본문에는 바로가기 링크만 남겼다. 차트에는 `전체`/`최근 10년`/`최근 5년` 기간 프리셋과 초기화 버튼을 추가했다.
- **끝점 라벨 + 상위 보기** — 차트 배경을 흰색으로 정리하고, 선 끝 라벨·최근 연도순 정렬·상위 5/10 보기 제어를 추가했다.
- **탐색기 통합** — 원데이터 표를 기관 문헌 수 탐색기 페이지로 함께 옮기고, 기관 선택 검색과 `PNG`/`SVG` 저장 버튼을 추가했다.
